key_points: Aksha is an intelligent surveillance system designed for automated monitoring with minimal human intervention.
Utilizes advanced technologies such as Computer Vision, Artificial Intelligence, and Generative AI for enhanced functionality.
Capable of detecting objects and unusual situations, enabling proactive responses and analysis.
Offers multiple architectural configurations: On-Premise, Edge + Cloud, and Cloud-based UI with Edge Backend.
Facilitates flexibility in deployment to meet diverse business needs and operational environments.
Supports seamless integration with existing infrastructure for enhanced scalability and performance.
Live data recording and processing with real-time object detection capabilities.
Advanced image analysis powered by Generative AI, identifying various objects and anomalies.
Customizable alert system that empowers users to set alerts tailored to their specific operational requirements.
Clients report significant reductions in human monitoring efforts and enhanced CCTV utility.
Positive feedback highlights the system's ability to detect abnormal events, improving safety and operational efficiency.
Customers express eagerness for future updates and innovations, indicating strong trust in Aksha's capabilities.
Effortless scalability through microservices managed by Kubernetes, accommodating high message volumes with Kafka.
Decoupled architecture enhances service development and deployment, improving fault tolerance.
Real-time data processing ensures timely insights and actions, maintaining high availability and performance.
Installation requires access to the same network as the camera or RTSP links for integration.
Compatible with any standard CCTV camera that provides RTSP links, ensuring broad applicability.
Simple installation steps facilitate quick deployment and integration into existing surveillance systems.
For more information, visit our website: https://aksha.algoanalytics.com/
Contact us at: aksha@algoanalytics.com for inquiries or support.
Visit our office at Alacrity India Innovation Centre, Pune for a personal demonstration.
